research.summary: At 128 regs with 8-byte prepare spills vs 0-spill prefetch and 24KiB shared, the only affordable latency hiding is address-only distance-1 L2 lookahead overlapped with point-add field math, plus live-range shortening to preserve 0-spill. No GPU timing claimed.

findings.title: Address-only rolling L2 lookahead (distance-1) overlapped with field arithmetic
findings.mechanism: Compute next-window index/address one iteration early and issue L2 hint, overlapping with current-window point-add field muls/squares. Keep only address/index live, not next X/Y point, preserving the 0-spill form. Rolling form avoids re-paying latency each batch if fenced correctly; L2 path avoids extra shared/register buffer.

sources.locator: Unrolling / Rolling prefetch / L2 variant sections
sources.supports: Compiler can overlap independent loads only with distinct registers; rolling uses same resources as batched but avoids repeated latencies; sync forces completion so async copy needed; L2-from-global variant via PTX useful when shared too small

sources.locator: Contents: Data Movement Instructions prefetch, prefetchu
sources.supports: PTX ISA exposes prefetch/prefetchu instructions; supports existence only, not latency guarantee

findings.new_vs_memory: Memory records loaded-next-point (128 regs + 8B spill) vs L2-prefetch (128 regs, 0 spills, hints late in SASS, overlap unmeasured). This refines to address-only distance-1 as the spill-free form, not full next-point load; explains spill difference as extra live point state.
findings.large_gain_case: Removed work: serial load-use stall per window in prepare chain. Added work: one early index/address calc plus L2 hint overlapped with existing field arithmetic. Large only if Stall Long Scoreboard on table loads dominates and bandwidth underutilized; no percentage claimed.
findings.risks: Compiler/CUDA may sink hint late as already observed in SASS; distance>1 re-adds live regs and spills; divergent addresses serialize; no occupancy gain guaranteed at 128 regs.
findings.falsification: Mac-only: compare ptxas -v regs/spills and check PTX/SASS hint placement before first use; reuse CPU 414-chain and next-load address check; no timing claim.

findings.title: Live-range splitting and recompute to hold 0-spill at 128 regs
findings.mechanism: Shorten live ranges in prepare: recompute window indices on demand, drop table-point regs immediately after add, split address/load vs accumulate phases, avoid holding deferred-Y/accumulator across full chain. If spill unavoidable, consider explicit shared-memory spill slot instead of local-memory spill.

sources.supports: Multiple-precision arithmetic requires a lot of register resources, premise is to spread value across thread group within warp; shows load/compute/store structure

sources.locator: Abstract (metadata/abstract only, full text not verified)
sources.supports: Authors state registers often limit occupancy, nvcc spills excess to off-chip ignoring shared, RegDem SASS spill to shared improves over nvcc with 9% geomean up to 18% author-measured on their workloads; not grinding/GPU-throughput transfer

sources.locator: When is Local Memory Used? / How Does LMEM Affect Performance?
sources.supports: Exceeding register limit uses local memory for spills; hurts via increased memory traffic and instruction count

findings.new_vs_memory: Memory records 128-reg prepare with 8B spill vs 0-spill prefetch, 24KiB shared, finish 80 regs 0 spills. This is scheduling to keep 0-spill without adding prefetch live state, distinct from rejected blanket cooperative 2/4-lane and from adding full-point lookahead.
findings.large_gain_case: Removed work: local-memory spill loads/stores and extended live state in hot prepare loop. Added work: index recompute ALU or small shared spill traffic plus potential sync. Large only if spills sit in hot loop and occupancy is register-limited; no percentage claimed.
findings.risks: Recompute adds ALU and pressure; shared spill risks bank conflicts, sync/fence breaking overlap, and reduced occupancy; may re-inflate regs.
findings.falsification: Mac-only: native ptxas -v spill bytes and Nsight-occupancy estimate from regs/shared only; CPU correctness unchanged; no GPU speed claim.

research.next_question: Can distance-1 address-only L2 hint be placed before current-window field math in PTX/SASS while holding 128 regs / 0 prepare spills, and does ptxas report Stall Long Scoreboard relief without GPU timing?
